name: MetaSea
rootCause: MetaSea's SEA round product on Arbitrum was drained on 2026-05-17 when a flash-loan-funded helper contract repeatedly opened and redeemed positions in the same transaction, extracting SEA from a shared distributor and netting 13,904.941068 USDT in the focal exploit. The round contract let a caller open and redeem in the same transaction, then claim SEA from a shared distributor using accumulated rewards rather than a time-weighted, per-position entitlement.
